```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T79U-54'
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        bt.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id AND p.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.qty), 0) AS total_qty
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'BE-2908';
```

```sql
        p.product_id AS root_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id

      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)

        bt.root_id,

        bt.qty * b.per_assembly_qty

      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of FR-R38R-52
    SELECT 
        p_assembly.product_id AS assembly_product_id,
        p_assembly.product_number AS assembly_product_number,
        p_component.product_id AS component_product_id,
        p_component.product_number AS component_product_number,
        p_component.make_flag,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_assembly,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS bom_level
    FROM product p_assembly
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p_assembly.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN product p_component ON bom.component_id = p_component.product_id
    WHERE p_assembly.product_number = 'FR-R38R-52'
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of manufactured sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        bt.component_product_id AS assembly_product_id,
        p_assembly.product_number AS assembly_product_number,
        p_component.product_id AS component_product_id,
        p_component.product_number AS component_product_number,
        p_component.make_flag,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_assembly,
        bt.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bt.bom_level + 1 AS bom_level
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN product p_assembly ON bt.component_product_id = p_assembly.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p_assembly.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN product p_component ON bom.component_id = p_component.product_id
    WHERE bt.make_flag = true  -- only expand manufactured assemblies
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_needed
FROM bom_tree
WHERE component_product_number = 'MS-1981';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Start with the top-level product
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        p.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS per_assembly_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T79U-54'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode BOM components
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.per_assembly_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS per_assembly_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1 AS bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion be

    WHERE bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'

      AND p.make_flag = TRUE  -- Only recurse into manufactured (sub-assembly) components

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of FR-M21B-42
    SELECT 
        p_assembly.product_id AS assembly_product_id,
        p_assembly.product_number AS assembly_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        p_component.product_number AS component_product_number,
        p_component.make_flag,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN product p_assembly ON bom.assembly_id = p_assembly.product_id
    JOIN product p_component ON bom.component_id = p_component.product_id
    WHERE p_assembly.product_number = 'FR-M21B-42'
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: sub-components of manufactured components
    SELECT 
        bt.component_id AS assembly_product_id,
        bt.component_product_number AS assembly_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        p_component.product_number AS component_product_number,
        p_component.make_flag,
        bt.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bt.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN product p_component ON bom.component_id = p_component.product_id
    WHERE bt.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_needed
FROM bom_tree
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(assembly_id, component_id, qty_per_assembly, depth) AS (
    SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty, 1
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE '2023-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT bt.assembly_id, b.component_id, bt.qty_per_assembly * b.per_assembly_qty, bt.depth + 1
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials b
      ON bt.component_id = b.assembly_id
     AND b.start_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
     AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2023-01-01')
    WHERE bt.depth < 20
),
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
),
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN target_product tp ON sol.product_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
),
component_demand AS (
    SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty * bt.qty_per_assembly) AS total_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON sol.product_id = bt.assembly_id
    JOIN target_product tp ON bt.component_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
      AND bt.depth >= 1
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT total_qty FROM direct_demand), 0) 
     + COALESCE((SELECT total_qty FROM component_demand), 0) AS total_demand;
```

```sql
    -- Start with direct components of the top-level product

        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty,

    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON bom.assembly_id = bt.product_id

        br.per_assembly_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS per_assembly_qty,
        br.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_recursive br ON bom.assembly_id = br.component_id
    JOIN product p ON br.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Start from all products that directly contain ST-9828 in current BOM
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS product_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN product p ON bom.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'ST-9828'
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse up: find products that contain these assemblies
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS product_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bom.component_id = bp.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS num_products
FROM bom_paths;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_bom AS (
    -- Get all current BOM lines (excluding header rows where assembly_id IS NULL)
    SELECT 
        assembly_id,
        component_id,
        per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-06-30')
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct assemblies that contain TO-2301
    SELECT 
        p_assembly.product_id AS root_product_id,
        p_assembly.product_number AS root_product_number,
        cb.assembly_id,
        cb.component_id,
        cb.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom cb
    JOIN product p_component ON cb.component_id = p_component.product_id
    JOIN product p_assembly ON cb.assembly_id = p_assembly.product_id
    WHERE p_component.product_number = 'TO-2301'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: assemblies that contain sub-assemblies that eventually contain TO-2301
    SELECT 
        bp.root_product_id,
        bp.root_product_number,
        cb.assembly_id,
        cb.component_id,
        cb.per_assembly_qty * bp.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom cb
    JOIN product p_component ON cb.component_id = p_component.product_id
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON p_component.product_id = bp.assembly_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_product_id) AS product_count
FROM bom_paths;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the specified bikes
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.parent_code,
        c.qty,
        c.unit,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to,
        1 AS level
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code IN ('BK-T44U-46', 'BK-M18B-52')
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of manufactured components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.parent_code,
        c.qty,
        c.unit,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to,
        bt.level + 1
    FROM u_composition c
    INNER JOIN bom_tree bt ON c.parent_code = bt.child_code
    INNER JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bt.child_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
parts_in_bikes AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.child_code AS part_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bt.parent_code = 'BK-T44U-46' OR 
                  EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM bom_tree bt2 
                      WHERE bt2.child_code = bt.child_code 
                        AND bt2.parent_code = 'BK-T44U-46'

        MAX(CASE WHEN bt.parent_code = 'BK-M18B-52' OR 
                  EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM bom_tree bt3 
                      WHERE bt3.child_code = bt.child_code 
                        AND bt3.parent_code = 'BK-M18B-52'
                  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_m18
    FROM bom_tree bt
    INNER JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bt.child_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = false  -- only purchased parts
    GROUP BY bt.child_code
)
SELECT part_number
FROM parts_in_bikes
WHERE in_t44 = 1 AND in_m18 = 0
ORDER BY part_number;
```

```sql
        be.child_code,

        be.valid_from,
        be.valid_to
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bom_edges be ON bp.child_code = be.parent_code
```

```sql
    LEFT JOIN bom_paths bp ON bp.parent_code = p.product_number
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get current date
current_date AS (SELECT DATE '2025-06-30' AS d),

-- Get category_id for 'Bikes'
bike_category AS (
    SELECT category_id 
    FROM product_category 
    WHERE name = 'Bikes'
),

-- Get product_ids for the two bikes
target_bikes AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number IN ('BK-T44U-46', 'BK-M18B-52')
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for a given product
bom_explosion(product_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty, depth) AS (
    -- Base case: direct components from BOM lines valid on current date
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty,
        1
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    CROSS JOIN current_date c
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= c.d
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= c.d)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components that are themselves assemblies
    SELECT 
        e.product_id,
        b.component_id,
        e.per_assembly_qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        e.depth + 1
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON e.component_id = b.assembly_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date c
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= c.d
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= c.d)
),

-- Get all parts (leaf components, make_flag = false) for BK-T44U-46
parts_in_bike1 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.product_number
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN target_bikes tb ON be.product_id = tb.product_id
    WHERE tb.product_number = 'BK-T44U-46'
      AND p.make_flag = false
),

-- Get all parts (leaf components, make_flag = false) for BK-M18B-52
parts_in_bike2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.product_number
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN target_bikes tb ON be.product_id = tb.product_id
    WHERE tb.product_number = 'BK-M18B-52'
      AND p.make_flag = false
)

-- Parts in BK-T44U-46 but not in BK-M18B-52
SELECT product_number
FROM parts_in_bike1
WHERE product_number NOT IN (SELECT product_number FROM parts_in_bike2)
ORDER BY product_number
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current date for BOM validity
current_bom AS (
    SELECT '2025-06-30'::DATE AS as_of_date
),
-- Get product IDs for the two bikes
bike_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id AS m18s_id,
        (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-R79Y-42') AS r79y_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'BK-M18S-40'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for BK-M18S-40
m18s_components AS (
    -- Start with direct components of BK-M18S-40
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    CROSS JOIN current_bom cb
    JOIN bike_products bp ON bom.assembly_id = bp.m18s_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= cb.as_of_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR cb.as_of_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id,
        mc.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM m18s_components mc
    JOIN product p ON mc.component_id = p.product_id
    CROSS JOIN current_bom cb
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= cb.as_of_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR cb.as_of_date <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for BK-R79Y-42
r79y_components AS (
    -- Start with direct components of BK-R79Y-42
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    CROSS JOIN current_bom cb
    JOIN bike_products bp ON bom.assembly_id = bp.r79y_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= cb.as_of_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR cb.as_of_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id,
        rc.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM r79y_components rc
    JOIN product p ON rc.component_id = p.product_id
    CROSS JOIN current_bom cb
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= cb.as_of_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR cb.as_of_date <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Get distinct parts (make_flag = false) from each bike
m18s_parts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.component_id
    FROM m18s_components mc
    JOIN product p ON mc.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
),
r79y_parts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT rc.component_id
    FROM r79y_components rc
    JOIN product p ON rc.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
)
-- Parts in BK-M18S-40 but not in BK-R79Y-42
SELECT p.product_number
FROM m18s_parts m
JOIN product p ON m.component_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN r79y_parts r ON m.component_id = r.component_id
WHERE r.component_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.product_number;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all orders from Central territory in 2025 with their order lines
central_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        sol.line_total
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- Start with products that are assemblies (have BOM lines)
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of products sold
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty_per_unit,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON co.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR co.order_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty_per_unit,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = be.component_id AND p.make_flag = true)
),

-- Get the part MS-2348
part_ms2348 AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-2348'
),

-- Direct sales of MS-2348
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty), 0) AS direct_units
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    JOIN part_ms2348 p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
),

-- Component demand: MS-2348 used in assemblies sold
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(be.order_qty * be.total_qty_per_unit), 0) AS component_units
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN part_ms2348 p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
)

SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_units FROM direct_sales) + 
    (SELECT component_units FROM component_demand) AS total_demand
```

```sql
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get the part TT-M928's product_id
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'TT-M928'
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from products sold to their components
-- We need to explode BOMs valid on each specific order date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: products directly ordered
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS current_product_id,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty,
        co.order_date,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode components
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
),
-- Get direct sales of TT-M928
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty), 0) AS direct_qty
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    JOIN target_part tp ON co.product_id = tp.product_id
),
-- Get component demand (TT-M928 appearing as a component at any level)
component_demand AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.total_qty), 0) AS component_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN target_part tp ON be.current_product_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE be.bom_level >= 1  -- only count as component, not direct
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_qty FROM direct_sales) + 
    (SELECT component_qty FROM component_demand) AS total_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Central territory in 2023 with their order dates
central_orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.territory_group = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Find the part MS-1981
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'MS-1981'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track: the original sold product, the component at current level, quantity multiplier, and order date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: products sold directly (level 0, they are the "component" of themselves with qty 1)
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS total_qty,
        co.order_date,
        co.order_qty AS order_quantity
    FROM central_orders_2023 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode components
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.order_quantity
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      -- Only recurse if the current component is an assembly (make_flag = true)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = be.component_id AND p.make_flag = true)
),

-- Get all exploded lines including the root products themselves
all_components AS (
    SELECT 
        root_product_id,
        component_id,
        total_qty,
        order_date,
        order_quantity
    FROM bom_explosion
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include direct sales of parts (products with no BOM or make_flag = false)
    -- These are already in bom_explosion, but we need to make sure we capture when MS-1981 is sold directly
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS total_qty,
        co.order_date,
        co.order_qty AS order_quantity
    FROM central_orders_2023 co
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM bill_of_materials bom 
        WHERE bom.assembly_id = co.product_id
          AND bom.start_date <= co.order_date
          AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR co.order_date <= bom.end_date)
    )
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = co.product_id AND p.make_flag = false)
),

-- Calculate total demand for MS-1981: sum of (order_qty * bom_multiplier) for all occurrences
demand_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ac.order_quantity * ac.total_qty) AS total_demand
    FROM all_components ac
    JOIN target_part tp ON ac.component_id = tp.product_id
)

SELECT COALESCE(total_demand, 0) AS total_demand_for_ms_1981
FROM demand_calculation;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all orders from Northwest territory in 2022
northwest_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, so.territory_id
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),

-- Get order lines for these orders with their quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        no.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN northwest_orders no ON sol.order_id = no.order_id
),

-- Find the product_id for part NI-4127
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'NI-4127'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOMs: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track: the original order line, the component we need, and the cumulative quantity
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: the products directly ordered
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS assembly_id,
        ol.product_id AS component_id,
        ol.order_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode components that are assemblies (make_flag = true)
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        bom.component_id AS assembly_id,
        bom.component_id AS component_id,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
),

-- Get all leaf-level components (parts) from the explosion, plus direct parts
all_components AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.component_id,
        be.cumulative_qty,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false  -- only purchased parts
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include directly ordered parts (that don't have BOMs or aren't exploded)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS component_id,
        ol.order_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN product p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
),

-- Deduplicate: for each order and component, we want the total from all paths
-- Actually, we need to sum over all paths, so let's aggregate
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        component_id,
        SUM(cumulative_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM all_components
    GROUP BY order_id, component_id
)

-- Final answer: total demand for NI-4127
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cd.total_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM component_demand cd
JOIN target_part tp ON cd.component_id = tp.product_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the product_id for part TT-R982
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'TT-R982'
),

-- Get all orders from UK territory in 2024
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'United Kingdom'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' 
      AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from products sold to target part
-- Start from products that appear in order lines and have BOMs
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: products sold directly (these are the assembly products we start from)
    -- We need to find if target part is a component at any level
    SELECT 
        uo.order_id,
        uo.order_date,
        uo.product_id AS assembly_id,
        uo.product_id AS component_id,
        uo.order_qty AS path_qty,
        0 AS bom_level,
        CAST(uo.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_component_qty
    FROM uk_orders_2024 uo
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components that are assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.path_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1,
        CAST(be.path_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND be.bom_level < 10  -- safety limit
),

-- Find all usages of target part in the BOM expansions
target_part_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_component_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id
),

-- Direct sales of target part (sold as the main product, not as component)
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        uo.order_id,
        uo.order_date,
        CAST(uo.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS direct_qty
    FROM uk_orders_2024 uo
    JOIN target_part tp ON uo.product_id = tp.product_id
)

-- Sum: direct sales + component usage
SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(direct_qty) FROM direct_sales), 0) + 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_component_qty) FROM target_part_usage), 0) AS total_demand
```

```sql
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id

    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id

      AND so.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),
bom_expansion AS (

    SELECT 
        sol.product_id as top_level_product_id,
        sol.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as total_qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN northwest_orders no ON sol.order_id = no.order_id

        be.top_level_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
```

```sql
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- For each order line, we need to trace through BOM valid on that order date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: the sold product itself (level 0)
    SELECT 
        co.sold_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date,
        co.sold_product_id AS current_product_id,
        1.0 AS cumulative_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode components
    SELECT 
        be.sold_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1 AS bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date 
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
        AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows

    -- Direct sales of MS-2341

    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    JOIN part_ms2341 p ON co.sold_product_id = p.product_id
    
    UNION ALL

        SUM(be.order_qty * be.cumulative_qty) AS total_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
```

```sql
    SELECT so.order_id
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2022-12-31'
),
bike_products AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
bom_hierarchy AS (
    -- Start with bikes that have order lines in Northeast 2022
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        p.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS cumulative_qty,
        sol.order_qty AS order_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN northeast_orders no ON sol.order_id = no.order_id
    JOIN bike_products p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode BOM
    SELECT 
        bh.top_level_product_id,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bh.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        bh.order_qty
    FROM bom_hierarchy bh
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bh.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- Calculate total units sold (direct + all components)
bike_units AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_number,
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty), 0) AS direct_units
    FROM bike_products p
    LEFT JOIN sales_order_line sol ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    LEFT JOIN northeast_orders no ON sol.order_id = no.order_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_number
)
SELECT product_number
FROM bike_units
ORDER BY direct_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' 
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND so.territory_id IN (SELECT territory_id FROM germany_territory)
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from any product to FD-2342
-- We need to find how much FD-2342 is contained in each product sold
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: FD-2342 itself (0 levels up, quantity 1 of itself)
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as top_product_id,
        p.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as per_assembly_qty,
        0 as bom_level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain the current component
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id as top_product_id,
        bp.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.per_assembly_qty as per_assembly_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bom.component_id = bp.top_product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
),
-- For each order, calculate demand for FD-2342
-- This includes direct sales of FD-2342 and contained amounts
demand_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        go.product_id,
        go.order_qty,
        go.order_date,
        COALESCE(bp.per_assembly_qty, 0) as bom_qty
    FROM germany_orders go
    LEFT JOIN bom_paths bp ON go.product_id = bp.top_product_id
),
-- Sum up the demand: order_qty * bom_qty (where bom_qty is 1 for direct sales, or the path multiplier)
total_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(order_qty * COALESCE(bom_qty, 1)) as total_demand
    FROM demand_calc
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the product_id for FR-T98Y-54
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-T98Y-54'
),

-- Find territory_id for 'Central'
central_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Central'
),

-- Get all order lines from Central territory in 2025 with their order dates
central_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE so.territory_id = (SELECT territory_id FROM central_territory)
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: for each product ordered, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track: the original ordered product, and the accumulated quantity multiplier
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: the products directly ordered (they are "assemblies" of themselves with qty 1)
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        co.order_qty AS accumulated_qty,
        co.order_date,
        0 AS bom_level,
        CAST(co.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_component_qty
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode components
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.accumulated_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.bom_level + 1,
        be.accumulated_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),

-- Get all demands where FR-T98Y-54 appears (either directly sold or as component)
fr_t98y_54_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        be.component_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_component_qty AS demand_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    WHERE be.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include direct sales of FR-T98Y-54 itself (when it's the root product)
    SELECT 
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        co.order_date,
        CAST(co.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS demand_qty
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    WHERE co.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(demand_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM fr_t98y_54_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the product_id for FR-R92R-62
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
),

-- Get all Northeast territory orders in 2023
northeast_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01' 
      AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from any product to FR-R92R-62
-- We need to find where FR-R92R-62 appears as a component (at any level)
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct components where FR-R92R-62 is a component
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        bom.bom_level,
        1 AS depth
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN target_product tp ON bom.component_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain the paths we've found
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bp.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.qty_multiplier AS qty_multiplier,
        bom.bom_level,
        bp.depth + 1
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bom.component_id = bp.top_product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
),

-- For each order, we need BOM valid on the ORDER DATE, not current date
-- So we need to recalculate paths per order date
bom_paths_by_date AS (
    -- Base case: direct components where FR-R92R-62 is a component
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        bom.bom_level,
        1 AS depth,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN target_product tp ON bom.component_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain the paths we've found
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        bp.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.qty_multiplier AS qty_multiplier,
        bom.bom_level,
        bp.depth + 1,
        GREATEST(bom.start_date, bp.start_date) AS start_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN bom.end_date IS NULL THEN bp.end_date
            WHEN bp.end_date IS NULL THEN bom.end_date
            ELSE LEAST(bom.end_date, bp.end_date)
        END AS end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths_by_date bp ON bom.component_id = bp.top_product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Get valid paths for each specific order date
valid_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.top_product_id,
        bp.qty_multiplier,
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.order_qty
    FROM bom_paths_by_date bp
    JOIN northeast_orders no ON bp.top_product_id = no.product_id
    WHERE bp.start_date <= no.order_date
      AND (bp.end_date IS NULL OR bp.end_date >= no.order_date)
),

-- Direct sales of FR-R92R-62 itself
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.order_qty
    FROM northeast_orders no
    JOIN target_product tp ON no.product_id = tp.product_id
),

-- Combine direct and indirect demand
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct demand
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        order_qty AS total_demand
    FROM direct_sales
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Indirect demand (contained in other products)
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        order_qty * qty_multiplier AS total_demand
    FROM valid_paths
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_demand), 0) AS total_demand
FROM all_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_demand AS (
    -- Base case: direct sales of BB-9108 in Southwest territory in 2025
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BB-9108'
        AND st.name = 'Southwest'
        AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
        AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: BB-9108 as a component in other products sold
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id AS product_id,
        (sol.order_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty * bd.total_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_demand bd
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bd.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON bom.assembly_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE bom.component_id IN (
        SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BB-9108'
    )
        AND st.name = 'Southwest'
        AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
        AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
        AND bom.start_date <= so.order_date
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bom.end_date)
        AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- First, get all products that contain BB-9108 at any level
product_contains_bb9108 AS (
    -- Direct: products that have BB-9108 as immediate component
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS product_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit,
        1 AS level
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN product p ON bom.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BB-9108'
        AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
        AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: products that contain products that contain BB-9108
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS product_id,
        (pc.qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty) AS qty_per_unit,
        pc.level + 1
    FROM product_contains_bb9108 pc
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON pc.product_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
        AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Calculate total demand
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of BB-9108
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty), 0) AS direct_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BB-9108'
        AND st.name = 'Southwest'
        AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
        AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
indirect_demand AS (
    -- BB-9108 contained in other products sold
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty * pc.qty_per_unit), 0) AS indirect_qty
    FROM product_contains_bb9108 pc
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON pc.product_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
        AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
        AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_qty FROM all_demand) + 
    (SELECT indirect_qty FROM indirect_demand) AS total_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the product_id for HB-T721
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'HB-T721'
),

-- Find all UK territory IDs (there might be variations)
uk_territories AS (
    SELECT territory_id 
    FROM sales_territory 
    WHERE name = 'United Kingdom'
),

-- Get all order lines from UK in 2024 with their products
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' 
      AND so.order_date < '2025-01-01'
      AND so.territory_id IN (SELECT territory_id FROM uk_territories)
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product ordered, find all components at all levels
-- We need to find paths where HB-T721 appears as a component (at any level) of the ordered product
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: start from products that have BOMs (assemblies)
    -- We need to find all products that contain HB-T721, directly or indirectly
    -- Actually, we need to go from ordered product down to components
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as root_product_id,
        p.product_id as current_assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level,
        so.order_qty as root_order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN uk_orders_2024 so ON p.product_id = so.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND so.order_date >= bom.start_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components that are themselves assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.assembly_id as current_assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level,
        be.root_order_qty,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND be.order_date >= bom.start_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),

-- Combine direct sales of HB-T721 with component usage
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales: HB-T721 ordered directly
    SELECT 
        uo.order_qty as units,
        uo.order_date
    FROM uk_orders_2024 uo
    WHERE uo.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Component usage: HB-T721 found in BOM of other products
    SELECT 
        (be.total_qty * be.root_order_qty)::INT as units,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_expansion be
    WHERE be.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units), 0) as total_demand
FROM all_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base case: all products that have FK-9939 as a direct component in a BOM valid on each order date
    -- We need to find all paths from top-level products down to FK-9939
    -- First, get all BOM lines where component is FK-9939 (direct demand)
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN product p ON bom.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FK-9939'
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: find assemblies that contain the intermediate assembly
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bh.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bh.total_qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(bom.start_date, bh.start_date) AS start_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN bom.end_date IS NULL THEN bh.end_date
            WHEN bh.end_date IS NULL THEN bom.end_date
            ELSE LEAST(bom.end_date, bh.end_date)
        END AS end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_hierarchy bh ON bom.component_id = bh.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get the product_id for FK-9939
fk_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FK-9939'
),
-- Direct sales of FK-9939 in Northwest territory in 2024
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_qty AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN fk_product fp ON sol.product_id = fp.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),
-- Component demand: FK-9939 used in other products sold in Northwest territory in 2024
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_qty * bh.total_qty AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    JOIN bom_hierarchy bh ON sol.product_id = bh.assembly_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
      AND so.order_date >= bh.start_date
      AND (bh.end_date IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bh.end_date)
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM direct_sales), 0) + 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM component_demand), 0) AS total_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_bom AS (
    -- Base case: direct children in current BOM
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: start from all products that have RM-R600 as direct child
    SELECT 
        parent_code AS root_product,
        child_code,
        qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom
    WHERE child_code = 'RM-R600'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find parents that contain these assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS root_product,
        bp.child_code,
        c.qty * bp.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom c
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON c.child_code = bp.root_product
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_number
FROM product p
JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
  AND p.product_number IN (
      SELECT root_product FROM bom_paths
      UNION
      -- Also check if RM-R600 is directly in the bike's BOM
      SELECT parent_code FROM current_bom WHERE child_code = 'RM-R600'
  )
ORDER BY p.product_number;
```

```sql
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = be.component_code
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: products sold directly
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id

      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'

    SELECT 
        p_child.product_id,
        (be.total_qty * uc.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN product p_parent ON be.product_id = p_parent.product_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON p_parent.product_number = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product p_child ON uc.child_code = p_child.product_number
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON p_parent.product_id = sol.product_id

    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND uc.valid_from <= so.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Base case: direct components
    SELECT 
        p_parent.product_id AS parent_product_id,
        p_child.product_id AS child_product_id,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN product p_parent ON p_parent.product_number = c.parent_code
    JOIN product p_child ON p_child.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30' 
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of components
    SELECT 
        bom.parent_product_id,
        p_child.product_id AS child_product_id,
        bom.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = (SELECT product_number FROM product WHERE product_id = bom.child_product_id)
    JOIN product p_child ON p_child.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30' 
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND (SELECT make_flag FROM product WHERE product_id = bom.child_product_id) = true
),
cleaners_components AS (
    -- All products that are in 'Cleaners' subcategory, either directly or as a component
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_number
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON ps.subcategory_id = p.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON pc.category_id = ps.category_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Cleaners'
    
    UNION
    
    -- Components at any level that are in Cleaners subcategory
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_number
    FROM bom
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bom.child_product_id
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON ps.subcategory_id = p.subcategory_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Cleaners'
),
cleaners_bom AS (
    -- For each parent product, get the total quantity of Cleaners components needed
    SELECT 
        bom.parent_product_id,
        SUM(bom.total_qty) AS cleaners_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom
    JOIN cleaners_components cc ON cc.product_id = bom.child_product_id
    GROUP BY bom.parent_product_id
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN cp.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN sol.order_qty  -- Direct Cleaners product
                ELSE 0
            END +
            COALESCE(cb.cleaners_qty_per_unit, 0) * sol.order_qty  -- Cleaners components in BOM
        ),
        0
    ) AS total_cleaners_units_sold
FROM sales_order_line sol
JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
LEFT JOIN cleaners_components cp ON cp.product_id = sol.product_id
LEFT JOIN cleaners_bom cb ON cb.parent_product_id = sol.product_id
WHERE st.name = 'Germany'
  AND so.online_order = false
  AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (cp.product_id IS NOT NULL OR cb.parent_product_id IS NOT NULL);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Base case: direct components
    SELECT 
        p_parent.product_id AS parent_product_id,
        p_child.product_id AS child_product_id,
        p_child.product_number AS child_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN product p_parent ON p_parent.product_number = c.parent_code
    JOIN product p_child ON p_child.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of components
    SELECT 
        bom.parent_product_id,
        p_child.product_id AS child_product_id,
        p_child.product_number AS child_code,
        bom.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(bom.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN bom.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN bom.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(bom.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = bom.child_code
    JOIN product p_child ON p_child.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
      AND (bom.valid_to IS NULL OR bom.valid_to >= c.valid_from)
),
-- Get all products that are cranksets (direct or in BOM)
crankset_products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Cranksets'
    
    UNION
    
    SELECT DISTINCT bom.child_product_id AS product_id
    FROM bom
    JOIN product p ON bom.child_product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Cranksets'
),
-- Calculate demand: direct sales + component usage
demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of cranksets
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty AS units
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
      AND so.online_order = FALSE
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND sol.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM crankset_products)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Component usage: cranksets used in products that were sold
    SELECT 
        bom.child_product_id AS product_id,
        (sol.order_qty * bom.total_qty)::INT AS units
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN bom ON bom.parent_product_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
      AND so.online_order = FALSE
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND so.order_date >= bom.valid_from
      AND (bom.valid_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bom.valid_to)
      AND bom.child_product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM crankset_products)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units), 0)::BIGINT AS total_units
FROM demand;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all orders from Canada territory in 2025
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),
-- Get the product_id for TT-M928
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'TT-M928'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each order line, expand the product's BOM valid on order date
-- We need to find all paths from sold products to TT-M928
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: start from products directly sold in orders
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS current_product_id,
        p.product_number AS current_code,
        co.order_qty AS base_qty,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty,  -- quantity at this level
        1 AS level
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand to children through valid BOM edges
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        p_child.product_id AS current_product_id,
        p_child.product_number AS current_code,
        be.base_qty,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,  -- multiply quantities along the path
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN product p_parent ON p_parent.product_number = be.current_code
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.current_code
    JOIN product p_child ON p_child.product_number = uc.child_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      AND p_parent.make_flag = true  -- only expand manufactured products
),
-- Calculate demand for TT-M928: direct sales + component usage
tt_m928_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of TT-M928
    SELECT co.order_id, co.order_date, co.order_qty AS demand_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN target_part tp ON co.product_id = tp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- TT-M928 as component at any level
    SELECT be.order_id, be.order_date, be.total_qty AS demand_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN target_part tp ON be.current_code = tp.product_number
    WHERE be.level > 1 OR be.current_code != (SELECT product_number FROM target_part)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(demand_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM tt_m928_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Australia in 2025 with their product numbers and order dates
australia_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        p.product_number,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON c.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Australia'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from sold products to components
-- Start with the products sold directly (they have demand = order_qty as themselves)
-- Then recursively follow BOM edges valid on the order date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: the products sold directly
    SELECT 
        ao.order_id,
        ao.line_id,
        ao.product_number AS parent_code,
        ao.product_number AS child_code,
        ao.order_qty AS qty,
        ao.order_date,
        1 AS level,
        ao.order_qty AS total_qty  -- quantity at this level
    FROM australia_orders ao
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow BOM edges from manufactured products
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.level + 1,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.child_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      -- Only follow edges from manufactured products (make_flag = true)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_number = be.child_code AND p.make_flag = true)
),

-- Get all demand entries: both direct sales and component demands
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of parts (make_flag = false) - they are their own demand
    SELECT 
        ao.order_id,
        ao.line_id,
        ao.product_number AS part_code,
        ao.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM australia_orders ao
    JOIN product p ON ao.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Component demands from BOM explosion (only parts, i.e., make_flag = false)
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        be.child_code AS part_code,
        be.total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.child_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
)

-- Sum total demand for part PA-632U
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM all_demand
WHERE part_code = 'PA-632U';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the product_id for part PD-R853
part_info AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'PD-R853'
),

-- Get Canada territory
canada_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id
    FROM sales_territory
    WHERE name = 'Canada'
),

-- Get all order lines from Canada in 2023 with their order dates
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN canada_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from sold products to components
-- Starting from products that were actually sold
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct sales (the product itself sold)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS current_product_id,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty,
        co.order_date,
        1 AS level,
        CAST(co.product_id AS VARCHAR) AS path
    FROM canada_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand to children
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        bp.line_id,
        bp.root_product_id,
        p.product_id AS current_product_id,
        bp.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.level + 1,
        bp.path || '->' || CAST(p.product_id AS VARCHAR)
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN product parent_p ON parent_p.product_id = bp.current_product_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = parent_p.product_number
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = uc.child_code
    WHERE parent_p.make_flag = true  -- only expand manufactured products
      AND uc.valid_from <= bp.order_date 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get direct sales of PD-R853
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty), 0) AS direct_units
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN part_info pi ON co.product_id = pi.product_id
),

-- Get indirect demand (PD-R853 as component at any level > 0)
indirect_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(bp.total_qty), 0) AS indirect_units
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN part_info pi ON bp.current_product_id = pi.product_id
    WHERE bp.level > 1  -- not direct sale, but component
)

SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_units FROM direct_demand) + 
    (SELECT indirect_units FROM indirect_demand) AS total_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Base case: direct components from products in 'Road Frames' subcategory
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        p.make_flag,
        1.0 AS total_qty
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Road Frames'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode BOM for make_flag=true products
    SELECT 
        c.product_id,
        c.product_number,
        c.make_flag,
        b.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition uc ON b.product_number = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    WHERE b.make_flag = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get leaf parts (purchased components) and also keep the original Road Frames products themselves
road_frames_products AS (
    -- All products in Road Frames subcategory (both finished and their components)
    SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Road Frames'
),
-- Calculate demand: for each order line, find all Road Frames products that are either:
-- 1. The product itself (if it's in Road Frames), or
-- 2. A component in the BOM of the ordered product (if that component is in Road Frames)
demand AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_qty AS base_qty,
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id AS ordered_product_id
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON c.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'France'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
-- For each order line, check if the ordered product itself is in Road Frames
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        d.line_id,
        d.base_qty AS units
    FROM demand d
    JOIN road_frames_products rfp ON d.ordered_product_id = rfp.product_id
),
-- For each order line, find Road Frames components in the BOM
bom_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        d.line_id,
        (d.base_qty * b.total_qty)::INT AS units
    FROM demand d
    JOIN product op ON d.ordered_product_id = op.product_id
    JOIN bom b ON op.product_number = b.product_number
    JOIN road_frames_products rfp ON b.product_id = rfp.product_id
    WHERE b.make_flag = false  -- Only count leaf parts that are in Road Frames
       OR b.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM road_frames_products WHERE product_id NOT IN (
           -- Exclude if it's an intermediate make product
           SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM bom WHERE make_flag = true
       ))
),
-- Actually, let's simplify: we need all units of Road Frames products that were demanded
-- This includes: direct sales of Road Frames products + Road Frames products used as components
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of Road Frames products
    SELECT 
        d.base_qty AS units,
        d.ordered_product_id AS product_id
    FROM demand d
    WHERE d.ordered_product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM road_frames_products)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Road Frames products appearing as components in BOMs
    SELECT 
        (d.base_qty * b.total_qty)::INT AS units,
```

```sql
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'

-- Get the product_number for each order line product
order_line_products AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        co.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date
    FROM central_orders_2023 co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all components at all levels
-- Start with the direct product itself (as a "component" of itself for direct sales)
-- Then recursively follow BOM edges
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: the product itself (direct sales)
    SELECT 
        olp.order_id,
        olp.line_id,
        olp.product_number AS parent_code,
        olp.product_number AS child_code,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit,
        olp.order_qty,
        olp.order_date

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow BOM edges
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date

),
-- Calculate total demand for each component

        child_code AS part_number,
        SUM(qty_per_unit * order_qty) AS total_demand
    FROM bom_explosion
    GROUP BY child_code

FROM component_demand
```

```sql
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from products to their components
-- We need to expand each product in each order line to all its leaf parts
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: start from products that appear in order lines
    -- We track the original product_id and order_qty for later multiplication
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date,
        p.product_number AS parent_code,
        p.product_number AS child_code,
        1.0 AS accumulated_qty,  -- qty multiplier from root to current node
        p.make_flag
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOM edges
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.accumulated_qty * uc.qty AS accumulated_qty,
        p_child.make_flag
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.child_code = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product p_parent ON uc.parent_code = p_parent.product_number
    JOIN product p_child ON uc.child_code = p_child.product_number
    WHERE be.make_flag = true  -- only expand if current node is manufactured in-house
      AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),
-- Get leaf parts (make_flag = false) from the expansion
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        root_product_id,
        order_qty,
        order_date,
        child_code AS part_code,
        accumulated_qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_expansion
    WHERE make_flag = false
    
    UNION
    
    -- Also include products that are directly parts (no BOM expansion needed)
    -- These are products in orders that are not make_flag=true, or products with no BOM
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date,
        p.product_number AS part_code,
        1.0 AS qty_per_unit
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM u_composition uc 
          WHERE uc.parent_code = p.product_number
            AND uc.valid_from <= co.order_date
            AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR co.order_date <= uc.valid_to)

part_demand_per_order_line AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        root_product_id,
        order_qty,
        order_date,
        part_code,
        MAX(qty_per_unit) AS qty_per_unit  -- In case of multiple paths, we should sum, but let's check

),
-- Actually, we need to sum over all paths for the same part
-- Let me redo this properly
all_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        root_product_id,
        order_qty,
        order_date,
        child_code,
        accumulated_qty,
        make_flag
    FROM bom_expansion
),
-- For leaf nodes, we want total demand
final_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        ap.order_id,
        ap.root_product_id,
        ap.order_qty,
        ap.order_date,
        ap.child_code AS part_code,
        ap.accumulated_qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM all_paths ap
    WHERE ap.make_flag = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Direct parts with no BOM
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date,
        p.product_number AS part_code,
        1.0 AS qty_per_unit
    FROM central_orders_2025 co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
),
-- Sum quantities per path and then compute total demand
summed_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        root_product_id,
        order_qty,
        order_date,
        part_code,
```

```sql
    FROM u_composition uc
```

```sql
    JOIN product p_child ON uc.child_code = p_child.product_number

    -- Base case: each product is its own component with qty 1
    SELECT 
        ol.product_id AS root_id,
        ol.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS total_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOM edges
```
